Our story

It began very simply: outdoor training with a couple of bars and a tyre at Dassoudi beach.

The idea grew into a much bigger vision: a place where fitness brings people together and makes them stronger, physically and mentally.

Power Beach was built with support, donations and people who believe in it. Visitors give it 4.9 stars on Google.

Why the starfish

For the founder, the starfish stands for love, guidance, inspiration, regeneration, renewal and sustainability.

How it was built

  • August 2019: a sketch of the first bar frame

  • Digging the holes for the first bars

  • The first bars and a tyre on the sand

  • Hand-made weights, painted with starfish

  • The hand-painted Power Beach sign

Photos: Power Beach, 2019 and 2020

The vision

“The coolest muscle theme park the world has yet to see.”

An outdoor fitness playground where people of all nationalities, ages and backgrounds can train, connect and feel inspired. The original vision includes:

  • Calisthenics
  • Monkey bars
  • Rings
  • Climbing ropes
  • Battle ropes
  • Weights
  • Benches
  • Yoga
  • Dancing
  • Water stations
  • Changing facilities
  • Greenery
  • Community spaces

Where we are going

Power Beach wants to grow beyond Dassoudi: spots all over Cyprus, and one day internationally. This is the beginning of something much bigger.

For everyone

People of all nationalities, ages and backgrounds train here together.
